articles.title: Tedeum, en vivo: ante Milei, García Cuerva defendió la inversión en discapacidad y pidió dejar atrás la 'mezquindad política'
articles.summary: President Milei participated in the traditional Te Deum ceremony for Independence Day at the Metropolitan Cathedral, accompanied by cabinet members and national authorities.

articles.title: El Gobierno define los cambios en la Carta Orgánica del BCRA y avanza con un proyecto de 'cierre' del Estado como en EEUU
articles.summary: President Milei met with economic team members to define modifications to the Central Bank's Organic Charter aimed at penalizing monetary emission without backing for deficit financing.

articles.title: Giro a la derecha en América Latina: Javier Milei viajará a las asunciones de Keiko Fujimori en Perú y Abelardo de la Espriella en Colombia
articles.summary: President Milei will travel to Peru and Colombia in late July and early August to attend the inauguration ceremonies of right-wing leaders Keiko Fujimori and Abelardo de la Espriella.

articles.title: Ahora juega la casta: Javier Milei movió primero y fuerte para 2027
articles.summary: The Milei government is advancing efforts to eliminate mandatory primary elections (PASO) and reform electoral systems to facilitate the president's reelection in 2027.

articles.title: Javier Milei quiere modificar la Carta Orgánica del Banco Central e impulsará la reforma política y cambios en Inocencia Fiscal
articles.summary: President Milei announced plans to Congress to modify the Central Bank's Organic Charter and advance political reform and changes to fiscal innocence legislation as his government's next priorities.
